title: Glass Landmarks
description: Five independent landmark typologies rendered as monolithic translucent glass — pagoda, mosque, palace, observatory, library.
creative_direction: Each single is a different architectural archetype carved from a different colored glass: amber, obsidian-black, cyan, ruby, frost. Each demonstrates subsurface scattering, thickness variation color shifts, and interior lighting read through translucent walls.
